_readme: Held-out generic corpus for baking the J-Lens Jacobian AND fitting the tuned-lens baseline. These sentences are DISJOINT from data/prompts.json (no shared clue) so the lens directions are never fit on the items they are evaluated on. They mention the candidate entities/answers in neutral prose so the bake sees those tokens in ordinary contexts.
